response.rationale: A is the Skating Session that RinkService creates (src/business/rinkService.ts: "return this.sessions.create({"). B is the Session that bookings refer to by id in BookingRepository (src/persistence/bookingRepository.ts: "listBySession(sessionId: string): Booking[] {"). RinkService (node 21c65604dec116b1) calls BookingRepository.listBySession and groupBySession, and its holdSession and cancelSession methods also call into BookingRepository (node 2e3c5728fffb0180). In this rink domain, the session a booking points to is the skating session the service manages, so B is a reference to the same real-world thing (a time slot on the rink), not a separate concept. The main uncertainty is that no Session class definition is visible, so the link rests on names and call edges.
